verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server at docs.statsig.com/mcp that connects Statsig to agent tools like Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT, and a probe independently confirms the MCP docs page exists. Statsig is a SaaS platform, not an agent, so the server axis applies and is clearly met. Missing for 10: hands-on or community corroboration of the MCP server in use, and detail on the exposed tools and capabilities.
